core_meaning.primary_meaning: Athumani is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Uthman (Swahili form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Athumani corresponds to the Arabic form عُثْمَان (Arabic root ع ث م (ʿ-th-m); عُثْمَان (ʿUthmān)). Its core sense is athumani; uthman (swahili form). Athumani is the Swahili form of Arabic عُثْمَان (ʿUthmān), a male given name borne by the third caliph.
